entries.title: A new welcome shows you around, one part at a time
entries.body: A new installation opens on a Welcome aboard card that shows your window one part per press: the message box, a card, Activity and Tasks, each explained beside it. Three starters put the start of a first ask in the message box for you to finish. The welcome is the only card a new installation shows, and Tasks sits on the right from the start.

picture.alt: The Welcome aboard card showing Activity, a card and Tasks in its picture of the window, with Back and Next under it and three starters below.
